description: Display of double sided internally illuminated LCD digital screen measuring 2120mm (height) x 1338mm (width) at relocated bus shelter on the public highway outside White City Warehouse, north of White City Underground Station.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The period of this consent shall expire 5 years from the date of this notice. 

Condition required to be imposed by the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) Regulations 2007.
Condition : 2 - The advertisement hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this advertisement consent:

Existing and Proposed Application Site;
A279-95-0113-0035-01 rev A;
LCD Screen Specification;
Elevation Drawings.


To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - The advertisement hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:

- LCD Screen, Powder Coated Steel Alloy Outer Casing

The advertisement shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details, until removed. 

To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC8 and DC9 of the Local Plan (2018).
Condition : 4 - ILLUMINATION
The luminance of the display shall not exceed 300 cd/m� during hours of darkness and 5000 cd/m� (or lower as per manufacturer's specification) during daylight hours and shall be automatically adjusted according to ambient lighting conditions. 
The illumination of the advertisement shall comply with the recommendations of the Institution of Lighting Professionals in the 'Guidance Note 01/20: Guidance Notes for the Reduction of Obtrusive Light' and the 'Professional Lighting Guide No 5 (PLG05), 2014 - Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements'. The display shall be positioned, angled and operated so as to avoid glare, dazzle or light spillage that could adversely affect highway safety including drivers, cyclists and pedestrians), and the amenity of nearby residential properties. 
The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. 

To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of surrounding premises is not adversely affected by artificial lighting, in accordance with Policies CC12 and CC13 of the Local Plan 2018.
Condition : 5 - HOURS OF ILLUMINATION
The display shall not be illuminated between 00:00 and 05:00 hours unless otherwise agreed in writing by the LBHF.

In the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 6 - NON-INTERMITTENT 
Any illumination of the advertisements hereby approved shall not be intermittent and there shall be no changing light patterns. 

Intermittent illumination would be unacceptable in the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018)
Condition : 7 - NON-MOVING
The digital sign shall not display any moving, or apparently moving, images (including animation, flashing, scrolling three dimensional. 

Moving advertisements would be unacceptable in the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 8 - FREQUENCY
The advertisement shall change no more frequently than once every 10 seconds and shall not include any animation or exposed cathode tubing.

In the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 9 - INTERVALS
The interval between each piece of content on the digital display screens shall take place over a period no greater than one second; the complete screen shall change with no visual effects (including swiping or other animated transition methods) between displays and the display will include a mechanism to freeze the image in the event of a malfunction.

In the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 10 - ROAD SIGNS
No content on the digital display screens shall resemble traffic signs, as defined in section 64 of the Road Traffic Regulation Act 1984.

In the interests of public safety as it is likely to lead to confusion of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
Condition : 11 - BREAKDOWN
The screen shall be designed so that, in the event of breakdown or malfunction, it shall automatically power-off to prevent flashing error messages being displayed, and it shall be so maintained. The display shall be switched off within 24 hours and shall remain off until repaired.

In the interests of public safety as it is likely to distract the attention of drivers of vehicles, in accordance with Policy T1 of the Local Plan (2018) and Key Principle TR28 of the Planning Guidance Supplementary Planning Document (2018).
